production.note: US model years 2021-present. Launched as the 2021 M3 (BMW NA's release is titled 'The New 2021 BMW M3 Sedan and M4 Coupe'). Previously recorded as calendar years 2020-present: BMW M: G80 'produced since 2020' (series production began at Plant Munich in November 2020; US launch March 2021). Still on sale: on 2026-09-30 bmwusa.com listed the rear-wheel-drive M3 Competition Sedan (503 hp, 8-speed M Steptronic) separately from the M3 Competition xDrive (https://www.bmwusa.com/vehicles/m-series/m3-series/bmw-m3-sedan.html).

drivetrain.note: This record is the rear-wheel-drive M3 Competition. The M3 Competition xDrive (AWD, offered from summer 2021) is a separate model and gets its own record.

transmission.note: 8-speed M Steptronic (torque-converter automatic) with Drivelogic; the manual is offered only on the non-Competition M3.

weightLb.note: Single configuration (automatic sedan). The non-Competition manual M3 is 3,840 lb.
